title: Hyperbolic models and stability recognition for Coxeter groups
summary: Given a finite rank Coxeter system, we construct a hyperbolic space by coning off the wide parabolic subcomplexes of its Davis complex. The resulting space is ``stability recognizing'', in the sense that stable subspaces of the Davis complex are exactly the quasigeodesically connected subspaces whose images in the coned-off space are quasiisometrically embedded. Equivalently, the coned-off space is ``Morse recognizing'': a quasigeodesic in the Davis complex is Morse if and only if it is quasigeodesic in the coned-off space.
